text.p: Amnex Inc, Wednesday, said actions taken in the last three months have contributed to increases in savings in its fiscal third quarter.
The pay telephone company said in a statement that implementation of operating efficiencies during its fiscal third quarter are expected to provide annual savings of $3.6 million.
In addition, the company said it has agreements with preferred stock holders, which, when consummated, will strengthen the balance sheet.
Amnex said a new working capital financial agreement with CIT Group/Credit Finance Inc, which, upon closing will add $3.5 million in liquidity.
The company said the expected result of these actions will result in continued profit increases. Operating income, the company said rose 283 percent in the first six months of this year.
